title: RL generation
description: Why generation takes as long as it does. It is 57-66% of an E6 step and the half that moves: after the grouped-mm fix made training about 13x faster, generation did not move and the bottleneck relocated here. The driver's own view of the fan-out sits above what the serving engines report.

params.value: SELECT DISTINCT run_id AS value FROM "telemetry_v1.marinskyrl" WHERE service = 'marinskyrl' AND name = 'policy_step' AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND run_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Generation against training, per step
panels.description: The two halves of the step side by side. Generation is 57-66% of it and moves 95-139 s between steps; training is 21-27% and barely moves. The step range is generation's variance, not training's — which is why this board exists.

defaults.noValue: No inclusive-wall driver rows under root='step'. This build publishes no step timings.

params.value: SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '${__interval_ms} milliseconds', to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms)) AS t, json_get(attributes_json, 'phase') AS series, AVG(value) AS value FROM "telemetry_v1.marinskyrl" WHERE service = 'marinskyrl' AND name = 'phase_duration_seconds' AND json_get(attributes_json, 'role') = 'trainer' AND json_get(attributes_json, 'clock_domain') = 'inclusive_wall' AND json_get(attributes_json, 'root') = 'step' AND json_get(attributes_json, 'phase') IN ('generate', 'policy_train') AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Is it the tail, or the whole batch?
How far the slowest trajectory runs past the mean
panels.description: The longest single engine wait divided by the per-trajectory mean — about 7.6x on this run, a 93.6 s tail against a 12.3 s mean. Generation is tail-latency-bound: the step ends with the last trajectory, so the mean alone actively misleads.

defaults.noValue: No rollout counters. This build does not instrument the generation coroutines.

params.value: WITH counters AS ( SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '${__interval_ms} milliseconds', to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms)) AS bucket, json_get(attributes_json, 'step') AS s, json_get(attributes_json, 'counter') AS counter, MAX(value) AS value FROM "telemetry_v1.marinskyrl" WHERE service = 'marinskyrl' AND name IN ('rollout_wait_seconds', 'rollout_count') AND json_get(attributes_json, 'role') = 'trainer' AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ), per_step AS ( SELECT bucket, s, MAX(CASE WHEN counter = 'rollout_trajectory_count' THEN value END) AS trajectories, MAX(CASE WHEN counter = 'rollout_engine_await_seconds_sum' THEN value END) AS engine_seconds, MAX(CASE WHEN counter = 'rollout_engine_await_seconds_max' THEN value END) AS slowest FROM counters GROUP BY 1, 2 ) SELECT bucket AS t, AVG(slowest / NULLIF(engine_seconds / NULLIF(trajectories, 0), 0)) AS tail_over_mean FROM per_step GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Generated tokens per request
panels.description: Generated tokens per rollout request, as percentiles over the vLLM histogram. The step ends with the slowest sample, so the p99-over-p50 gap is what generation costs it, not the mean.

defaults.noValue: No request_generation_tokens histogram, in either the vllm namespace or the trainer's forwarded one.

params.value: WITH engine AS ( SELECT service, run_id, execution_uid, node_name, process_index, name, resource_attributes_json, attributes_json, timestamp_ms, seq, value FROM "telemetry_v1.vllm" WHERE name IN ('request_generation_tokens_bucket') AND service = 'vllm' AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND timestamp_ms >= name, resource_attributes_json, attributes_json, timestamp_ms, seq, value FROM "telemetry_v1.marinskyrl" WHERE name IN ('request_generation_tokens_bucket') AND json_get(attributes_json, 'metric_source') = 'vllm' AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) ), raw AS ( SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '${__interval_ms} milliseconds', to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms)) AS bucket, json_get(attributes_json, 'le') AS upper_bound, CASE name WHEN 'request_queue_time_seconds_bucket' THEN 'queue' WHEN 'request_prefill_time_seconds_bucket' THEN 'prefill' WHEN 'request_decode_time_seconds_bucket' THEN 'decode' WHEN 'e2e_request_latency_seconds_bucket' THEN 'end to end' WHEN 'time_to_first_token_seconds_bucket' THEN 'time to first token' WHEN PARTITION BY service, run_id, execution_uid, node_name, process_index, name, resource_attributes_json, attributes_json ORDER BY timestamp_ms, seq ) AS previous_value FROM engine ), deltas AS ( SELECT bucket, upper_bound, family, CASE WHEN previous_value IS NULL OR value < previous_value THEN NULL ELSE value - previous_value END AS delta FROM raw ), buckets AS ( SELECT bucket, family, upper_bound, SUM(delta) AS bucket_count FROM deltas WHERE delta IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ), ranked AS ( SELECT bucket, family, upper_bound, bucket_count, MAX(bucket_count) OVER (PARTITION BY bucket, family) AS total_count FROM buckets ), quantiles AS ( SELECT bucket, family, MIN(CASE WHEN upper_bound NOT IN ('+Inf', 'Inf') AND bucket_count >= total_count * 0.50 THEN CAST(upper_bound AS DOUBLE) END) AS p50, MIN(CASE WHEN upper_bound NOT IN ('+Inf', 'Inf') AND bucket_count >= total_count * 0.90 THEN CAST(upper_bound AS DOUBLE) END) AS p90, MIN(CASE WHEN upper_bound NOT IN ('+Inf', 'Inf') AND bucket_count t, label AS series, observed AS value FROM evidence ORDER BY 1

Time to first token and inter-token latency
panels.description: Prefill responsiveness and decode speed. Inter-token latency times the p99 length is the floor on the generate phase at any concurrency. Only TTFT survives the trainer's forwarder, so the ITL lines are often absent.

defaults.noValue: Neither histogram reached finelog from this run's engines. Never an instant prefill.

panels.title: Engine queue depth and why requests are waiting
panels.description: Mean queue depth per engine and the requests held back by each reason, averaged across engines rather than summed. A queue that never fills while the step waits is under-subscription; waiting on KV-cache is the opposite.

defaults.noValue: No queue gauges. These are gauges, so blank is an absent producer and never an empty queue.

params.value: WITH engine AS ( SELECT service, run_id, execution_uid, node_name, process_index, name, resource_attributes_json, attributes_json, timestamp_ms, seq, value FROM "telemetry_v1.vllm" WHERE name IN ('queue_depth', 'num_requests_waiting_by_reason') AND service = 'vllm' AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) UNION ALL SELECT service, run_id, execution_uid, node_name, process_index, name, resource_attributes_json, attributes_json, timestamp_ms, seq, value FROM "telemetry_v1.marinskyrl" WHERE name IN ('queue_depth', 'num_requests_waiting_by_reason') AND json_get(attributes_json, 'metric_source') = 'vllm' AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) ), gauges AS ( SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '${__interval_ms} milliseconds', to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms)) AS bucket, CASE WHEN name = 'queue_depth' THEN 'queue depth' ELSE 'waiting · ' || COALESCE(json_get(attributes_json, 'reason'), 'unknown') END AS label, value FROM engine ) SELECT bucket AS t, label AS series, AVG(value) AS value FROM gauges GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: KV-cache utilisation
panels.description: Mean and peak KV-cache occupancy across the run's engines, a gauge. Read it with the waiting-reason lines: a cache pinned near full while requests wait explains queueing that no amount of extra concurrency will clear, and a cache that stays empty says the engines had room the trainer never used.

defaults.noValue: No KV-cache gauge from this run's engines. Never an empty cache.

params.value: WITH engine AS ( SELECT service, run_id, execution_uid, node_name, process_index, name, resource_attributes_json, attributes_json, timestamp_ms, seq, value FROM "telemetry_v1.vllm" WHERE name IN ('kv_cache_usage_perc') AND service = 'vllm' AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) UNION ALL SELECT service, run_id, execution_uid, node_name, process_index, name, resource_attributes_json, attributes_json, timestamp_ms, seq, value FROM "telemetry_v1.marinskyrl" WHERE name IN ('kv_cache_usage_perc') AND json_get(attributes_json, 'metric_source') = 'vllm' AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) ), gauge AS ( SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '${__interval_ms} milliseconds', to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms)) AS bucket, value FROM engine ) SELECT bucket AS t, AVG(value) AS mean_usage, MAX(value) AS peak_usage FROM gauge GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
